metadata.summary: Magnetic thermal stage disabled by pipeline option.

notes: PSFB first-pass topology plugin; full backend/session integration is wired through the shared PE-Claw pipeline.
Secondary rectifier is modeled as an independent full-bridge diode path for future device selection.
Magnetic design stage: disabled for current semiconductor/thermal development focus.
PSFB primary switch voltage is treated as the maximum DC-link voltage in this first-pass model.

Operating-point waveform metadata supplies the PSFB primary-current stress; voltage stress remains design-corner based.
